entities.summary: Haj Muhammad Ben Abd as-Salam al-Muqri, alternatively transcribed as Mohammed El Mokri, was a senior Moroccan official of the late 19th and early 20th century. He was an adviser and grand vizier to several sultans of Morocco, including under French colonial domination.
